primary_goal: Drive user engagement by encouraging buyers to contact the private seller, buy directly, or browse alternative local listings.

friction_points.issue: Intrusive app banner occupies the entire top viewport, obscuring critical product images, title, and price.
friction_points.evidence: Image 1 shows a full-screen bright green app promotional overlay ('Entdecke mehr und wechsle zur App...') pushing all item details below the fold.

friction_points.issue: Missing primary contact action button near seller details or fixed sticky CTA bar.
friction_points.evidence: Image 2 displays the 'Anbieter' section (Vaso2026) without a clear 'Nachricht schreiben' or 'Direkt kaufen' CTA button.

friction_points.issue: Seller profile lacks sufficient trust signals and rating context for peer-to-peer transactions.
friction_points.evidence: Image 2 displays seller Vaso2026 with a generic grey avatar circle and an isolated number '1' badge without descriptive text or account tenure.

friction_points.issue: Repetitive ad banners clutter the recommended listings stream.
friction_points.evidence: Images 3, 4, and 5 repeat the exact same ad for 'Shima Bandit 2.0 schwarz/weiss 199,00 €' multiple times within 'Das könnte dich auch interessieren'.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add a sticky bottom CTA bar with 'Nachricht schreiben' and 'Direkt kaufen', then seller inquiry rates will increase because the main action is always reachable regardless of scroll position.
hypotheses.change: Implement a fixed mobile bottom bar containing 'Nachricht schreiben' and optional 'Direkt kaufen' buttons.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the full-viewport app banner with a discreet top banner, then item view duration and inquiry rates will increase because buyers immediately see the product image and price.
hypotheses.change: Change the green app promo from a full hero screen to a compact, dismissible banner.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display expanded seller reputation badges (e.g. response time, rating count, verification badges), then buyer contact conversion will increase due to higher seller confidence.
hypotheses.change: Enhance the 'Anbieter' section with detailed trust metrics such as 'Antwortet in der Regel innerhalb 1 Std.' and account registration year.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we deduplicate sponsored items in the recommendations feed, then click-through rate on recommended listings will increase because users receive diverse and relevant choices.
hypotheses.change: Apply ad deduplication logic to ensure unique ads and relevant local recommendations.

quick_wins: Deduplicate the display ad slot in the recommended items section so the same jacket ad does not repeat 3 times.
Add explicit label/explanation to the green '1' seller rating badge.
uncertainties: Whether a floating CTA appears when scrolling up or down on actual device interaction.
The appearance of the product hero gallery and price once the app installation banner is dismissed.
